market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Oil above $108 and bond selloff create a stagflationary pressure. Expect continued equity volatility, especially in rate-sensitive growth and import-dependent sectors. Bessent's failed buyback signals policy incoherence. 1-3 month: 5-10% equity drawdown risk if oil sustains $100+ and yields breach 5%.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (fiber, chips, cloud) and energy transition (nuclear restart, EV capex) provide structural growth. Trade war and geopolitical risks are cyclical. 6-12 month: recovery likely if oil normalizes and Fed pivots; favor quality, cash-flow-generative names over speculative multiples.
